startUrls.title: Pages to read
startUrls.description: Public https pages. Each one comes back as clean Markdown with hidden text removed, plus an injection verdict. Blocked pages are reported and not charged.

dropHostile.title: Drop Markdown of hostile pages
dropHostile.description: If a page is judged hostile, return its verdict and findings but no Markdown, so nothing from it reaches your model.

includeFindings.title: Include findings
includeFindings.description: Every finding with kind, severity and where it was (visible, hidden, decoded).
